title: Engagement Ring Insurance and How to Get It
audience: Couples in their 30s, affluent, interested in a destination wedding and other luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: Plan ref WW-049 given by the person; no plan document with that ref is in the repo, recorded as given.
Fast mode: 02, 03 and 04 in parallel after the brief; 5 SERP cities; editor and readers in parallel; one combined final pass.
Insurance is a financial product: general information only. Never recommend a policy or insurer. One plain line: general information, not advice; read the policy wording (PDS/TMD) before buying.
No insurer names (same rule as jewellers). No premiums, excess amounts, sums or 'costs about X% of value' rules of thumb (person's no-prices standard).

Sources: ASIC Moneysmart, Understand Insurance (Insurance Council of Australia), General Insurance Code of Practice, AFCA, Smartraveller, Jewellers Association of Australia (valuations). Anything unsupported becomes 'check your policy' wording.

Cover: contents policy (specified/listed items vs blanket/unspecified), standalone jewellery policy, travel insurance limits on valuables; policy checks (loss/theft/damage, overseas cover, agreed vs market value, replace vs cash, excess, conditions); valuations and paperwork (grading report, receipt, photos, inscription); insure from day of purchase incl. proposal abroad; travelling to a destination wedding; making a claim and AFCA; lab-grown vs natural valuation (link lab-grown post).
Overlap: ring settings and ring styles posts have short insurance/travel sections (JAA two-year revaluation, Smartraveller link). This is the full version; backlinks from those.
Firecrawl out of credits: use Apify web-fetch, DataForSEO on_page_instant_pages or search summaries, and record which.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
